mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO after_sales_outbox (event_id, aggregate_id, event_type, payload, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{aggregateId}, #{eventType}, #{payload}, #{status}, NOW(6), NOW(6))
mapper.select: SELECT event_id, aggregate_id, event_type, payload, status, retry_count, next_attempt_at, locked_by, locked_until, last_error, delivered_at FROM after_sales_outbox WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY') AND next_attempt_at <= #{now} AND (locked_until IS NULL OR locked_until < #{now}) ORDER BY created_at LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE after_sales_outbox SET locked_by = #{workerId}, locked_until = #{lockedUntil}, updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY') AND next_attempt_at <= #{now} AND (locked_until IS NULL OR locked_until < #{now})

UPDATE after_sales_outbox SET status = 'DELIVERED', delivered_at = #{deliveredAt}, locked_by = NULL, locked_until = NULL, last_error = NULL, updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND locked_by = #{workerId}

UPDATE after_sales_outbox SET status = #{status}, retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, last_error = #{lastError}, locked_by = NULL, locked_until = NULL, updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND locked_by = #{workerId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO after_sales_event_consume (event_id, consumer_name, status, consumed_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{consumerName}, 'PROCESSING', NULL, NOW(6), NOW(6))
